The '''Water Plant''' was a [[Water/Legends|water]] treatment facility at [[The Puddle]]. The plant consisted of intake pipes, the water processor, and several large storage tanks. It was ringed by a five-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall [[Power fence/Legends|power fence]] with a single gate entrance.<ref name="HS" />
